intent: K1: make dev CI green, and make each of its three failures visible from this machine. Six documentation links resolved only on a case-insensitive filesystem and stopped Ubuntu at lint step 2, so lint steps 3 to 12 had not run on Linux since 2026-09-05. extract.ts's lazily imported app modules used relative specifiers, which cannot resolve from the data: URL tsx compiles that file into, so docs:check died on CI and passed here. The runtime smoke drove POST /api/missions/[id]/dispatch, which T-0129 deleted as an orphan with zero callers; the smoke was the caller the walk did not count.

reasons.evidence: fourteen anchored edits across eight files plus a 100-line oracle, over the express limit

no file under .github/workflows is touched. The CI failures are fixed in the code the workflows run: docs, a script and a test harness. The R2 ci-stateful-infra floor applies to the workflow definitions, which this batch leaves alone.

programme: K1 of the refactor and clean-up programme, executing the operator's ruling on Q-009: dev is made green first, and every later batch waits for its pushed commit's CI.
invariants: I1 A LINUX-ONLY DEFECT IS VISIBLE HERE. Each of the three failures is held by a check that fails on Windows, on Node 24, without Docker. A green local gate that cannot see what the runner sees is what cost six days.

I2 THE LAZY SPLIT SURVIVES THE FIX. extract.ts still imports no app module at module scope, which its header and tests/unit/b15-generated-blocks.test.ts require, so rendering a markdown table still never boots better-sqlite3. Only the specifier changed, from relative to absolute.

I3 NO DOCUMENTED BEHAVIOUR MOVES. Six link targets are corrected to the spelling the files already have; the visible link text, which still names the retired uppercase filename, is docs-14's subject and is left alone.

I4 THE SMOKE PROVES WHAT IT PROVED. It still asserts a run is created, that the backend assigned a run_id, that the run reconciles to completion with output and usage, and that a cancel is accepted. It reaches them through the doors that exist: promote, then the mission's own row.
commits: e6d8ac1a the K1 oracle, red at 3 of 3; 71f1ed7f the three fixes; 310ebc8e the record and mutants; 9fa9faa4 the navigator the suite never installed; a68597ae the census report cut at the pipe buffer; the chore commit that carries this update.
verification: Gate by exit code on the finished tree, stamp unmoved: lint 0 (56.7s), tsc 0 (3.8s), jest 0 (52.7s: 6927 tests, 686 suites), knip 0 (5.3s), canary 0 (1.0s), build 0 (28.6s), e2e 0 (165.0s: 272 passed), census 0 (50.0s), census:lines 0 (2.4s). Beside the gate: npx tsx scripts/docs/check.mts 0 (75 pages, 21 routes), check-doc-links 0, and b15-generated-blocks 0 (13 tests), which is the suite that holds extract.ts to lazy imports at module scope. The census rise is the oracle, 100 test lines, held with that reason. CI, on the pushed commit a68597ae: every job green (build-test-ubuntu, build-test-macos, boot-smoke on both, e2e-smoke, install-harness, docker-image, shell-custom-scripts, real-hermes-integration). That is the first green run since d84b7528 on 2026-09-05, 63 pushes earlier. Two further defects surfaced on the way and were fixed rather than deferred, each in its own commit: a node suite that installed window and document but not navigator, which Node 21 and later leak and the runners do not; and the census report, printed through console.log and cut at the 8 KB macOS pipe buffer by process.exit, which three census suites had never met because that job had been red since before they were written.
mutation: Three mutants against the committed tree at 71f1ed7f, all killed, each putting back one of the three defects: a link returned to the wrong case, a lazy import returned to a relative specifier, and the smoke pointed back at the deleted route. Committed as tests/fixtures/mutants/T-0147.json.
deviation: Two of the three fixes cannot be proved on this machine, and the record should not pretend otherwise. The tsx data-URL failure needs Node 20 and the CI runner; the smoke needs Docker and mock-hermes. What this machine proves is that the oracle now SEES all three, that docs:check and the b15 lazy-import contract still pass after the change, and that the promote path the smoke now uses exists with the fields it reads (POST /api/missions action promote returns 200 with the mission; GET /api/missions?id= returns run beside mission; GET /api/runs/[id] carries runId). The pushed run is the proof, and it is read before the next batch starts. The batch took two more commits than it opened with, because making CI green is not a change you can finish before you have seen the runner: each fix let the jobs reach a step that had not run since 2026-09-05, and the step then failed for its own reason. Both are recorded above and each carries its own regression check.
